title: kbingest map runs cargo when rust-toolchain.toml names a toolchain path
goal: CargoMapper reads rust-toolchain.toml and rust-toolchain at the worktree root as text and, when either sets a path key (a custom toolchain directory, per the rustup overrides page), skips Cargo with a note and runs no cargo command; a test named kbingest_map_cargo_toolchain_path proves no cargo call is logged (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F7)
